facts.fact: Jade（Petra 的搭档、向导）用绳索把客户 Henry 降到第二层地面
facts.anchor: who’s slowly being lowered down by Jade

facts.fact: Jade 用「蛋糕分层、层间霜里有洞」向客户 Henry 解释如何下到第三层
facts.anchor: Think of the Void like the layers of a cake, separated by frosting

facts.fact: 巨型星鼻鼬现身后龇出长黄牙盯住三人，Henry 握紧 Beast-Away Repellent Spray，巨鼬随即溜回树丛
facts.anchor: The weasel isn’t going to want to pick a three-against-one fight

facts.fact: Petra（叙述者、向导）在溪底挖出 strangleroot，刮表皮煮茶加蜂蜜递给患 Void sickness 的客户 Henry
facts.anchor: we have strangleroot tea. I add a little honey and hand it to Henry

facts.fact: Jade 把客户 Henry 背包里大部分装备转移进自己的包，替他减负
facts.anchor: She opens his backpack, transferring most of his equipment to hers

facts.fact: Petra 对客户 Henry 说那颗红色辉光宝石至少值 fifty nox，Henry 坚持送给她和 Jade、当作 tip
facts.anchor: It’s worth at least fifty nox

facts.fact: Henry 踩上松软地面将陷进空心蜘蛛陷阱时，Petra 抓住他的背包把他拽回，Jade 用 Beast-Away Repellent Spray 喷退空心蜘蛛
facts.anchor: Jade pulls out her Beast-Away Repellent Spray, blasting the red mist

facts.fact: 雾中出现第二个假 Jade 的声音诱走 Henry；四只瘦小苍白的手抓住他的脚踝把他拖进地下，背包肩带从 Petra 手里撕断
facts.anchor: I grab Henry’s backpack just as four skinny, pale hands wrap around his ankles
